build_transformer_encoder: build a transformer encoder model using the MODEL_BUILDERS registry with TransformerEncoder module
create_curriculum_fixed: create a fixed curriculum for length generalization experiments using CURRICULUM_BUILDERS
create_task_even_pairs: create an even_pairs task instance from TASK_BUILDERS for parity-based sequence generation
create_task_binary_addition: create a binary_addition task instance from TASK_BUILDERS for binary arithmetic sequences
lookup_task_level: lookup the task level category (regular, dcf, or cs) for any registered task in TASK_LEVELS
